name: 97 - Core - Data Retention and Cleanup - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BOOLEAN AS dry_run,
        $2::INTEGER AS batch_size,
        $3::INTEGER AS permission_days,
        $4::INTEGER AS delivery_days,
        $5::INTEGER AS attempt_days,
        $6::INTEGER AS audit_days,
        $7::INTEGER AS resolved_error_days,
        $8::INTEGER AS health_days,
        $9::INTEGER AS maintenance_days
),

permission_candidates AS (
    SELECT permission.id
    FROM communication_permission_checks permission
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE permission.checked_at <
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              days => request.permission_days
          )
    ORDER BY permission.id
    LIMIT (
        SELECT batch_size
        FROM request_data
    )
),

delivery_candidates AS (
    SELECT delivery.id
    FROM communication_delivery_events delivery
    INNER JOIN outbound_messages message
        ON message.id =
           delivery.outbound_message_id
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE delivery.event_at <
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              days => request.delivery_days
          )
      AND message.status IN (
            'delivered',
            'read',
            'failed',
            'blocked',
            'cancelled',
            'dead_letter'
          )
    ORDER BY delivery.id
    LIMIT (
        SELECT batch_size
        FROM request_data
    )
),

attempt_candidates AS (
    SELECT attempt.id
    FROM outbound_message_attempts attempt
    INNER JOIN outbound_messages message
        ON message.id =
           attempt.outbound_message_id
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE attempt.created_at <
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              days => request.attempt_days
          )
      AND message.status IN (
            'delivered',
            'read',
            'failed',
            'blocked',
            'cancelled',
            'dead_letter'
          )
    ORDER BY attempt.id
    LIMIT (
        SELECT batch_size
        FROM request_data
    )
),

audit_candidates AS (
    SELECT audit.id
    FROM system_audit_events audit
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE audit.created_at <
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              days => request.audit_days
          )
    ORDER BY audit.id
    LIMIT (
        SELECT batch_size
        FROM request_data
    )
),

error_candidates AS (
    SELECT error_event.id
    FROM workflow_error_events error_event
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE error_event.status IN (
            'resolved',
            'ignored'
          )
      AND error_event.updated_at <
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              days =>
                request.resolved_error_days
          )
    ORDER BY error_event.id
    LIMIT (
        SELECT batch_size
        FROM request_data
    )
),

health_candidates AS (
    SELECT snapshot.id
    FROM system_health_snapshots snapshot
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE snapshot.checked_at <
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              days => request.health_days
          )
    ORDER BY snapshot.id
    LIMIT (
        SELECT batch_size
        FROM request_data
    )
),

maintenance_candidates AS (
    SELECT maintenance.id
    FROM maintenance_runs maintenance
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE maintenance.status IN (
            'completed',
            'partial',
            'failed'
          )
      AND COALESCE(
            maintenance.completed_at,
            maintenance.started_at
          ) <
          NOW() -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(
              days =>
                request.maintenance_days
          )
    ORDER BY maintenance.id
    LIMIT (
        SELECT batch_size
        FROM request_data
    )
),

deleted_permissions AS (
    DELETE FROM communication_permission_checks permission
    USING permission_candidates candidate,
          request_data request
    WHERE request.dry_run = FALSE
      AND permission.id = candidate.id
    RETURNING permission.id
),

deleted_deliveries AS (
    DELETE FROM communication_delivery_events delivery
    USING delivery_candidates candidate,
          request_data request
    WHERE request.dry_run = FALSE
      AND delivery.id = candidate.id
    RETURNING delivery.id
),

deleted_attempts AS (
    DELETE FROM outbound_message_attempts attempt
    USING attempt_candidates candidate,
          request_data request
    WHERE request.dry_run = FALSE
      AND attempt.id = candidate.id
    RETURNING attempt.id
),

deleted_audits AS (
    DELETE FROM system_audit_events audit
    USING audit_candidates candidate,
          request_data request
    WHERE request.dry_run = FALSE
      AND audit.id = candidate.id
    RETURNING audit.id
),

deleted_errors AS (
    DELETE FROM workflow_error_events error_event
    USING error_candidates candidate,
          request_data request
    WHERE request.dry_run = FALSE
      AND error_event.id = candidate.id
    RETURNING error_event.id
),

deleted_health AS (
    DELETE FROM system_health_snapshots snapshot
    USING health_candidates candidate,
          request_data request
    WHERE request.dry_run = FALSE
      AND snapshot.id = candidate.id
    RETURNING snapshot.id
),

deleted_maintenance AS (
    DELETE FROM maintenance_runs maintenance
    USING maintenance_candidates candidate,
          request_data request
    WHERE request.dry_run = FALSE
      AND maintenance.id = candidate.id
    RETURNING maintenance.id
),

cleanup_result AS (
    SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        'dry_run',
            request.dry_run,

        'permission_checks',
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'candidates',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM permission_candidates
                    ),
                'deleted',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM deleted_permissions
                    )
            ),

        'delivery_events',
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'candidates',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM delivery_candidates
                    ),
                'deleted',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM deleted_deliveries
                    )
            ),

        'message_attempts',
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'candidates',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM attempt_candidates
                    ),
                'deleted',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM deleted_attempts
                    )
            ),

        'audit_events',
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'candidates',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM audit_candidates
                    ),
                'deleted',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM deleted_audits
                    )
            ),

        'resolved_errors',
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'candidates',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM error_candidates
                    ),
                'deleted',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM deleted_errors
                    )
            ),

        'health_snapshots',
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'candidates',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM health_candidates
                    ),
                'deleted',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM deleted_health
                    )
            ),

        'maintenance_runs',
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'candidates',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM maintenance_candidates
                    ),
                'deleted',
                    (
                        SELECT COUNT(*)
                        FROM deleted_maintenance
                    )
            )
    ) AS result
    FROM request_data request
),

inserted_run AS (
    INSERT INTO maintenance_runs (
        run_type,
        status,
        parameters,
        result,
        started_at,
        completed_at
    )
    SELECT
        'data_retention_cleanup',
        'completed',
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'dry_run',
                request.dry_run,
            'batch_size',
                request.batch_size,
            'permission_days',
                request.permission_days,
            'delivery_days',
                request.delivery_days,
            'attempt_days',
                request.attempt_days,
            'audit_days',
                request.audit_days,
            'resolved_error_days',
                request.resolved_error_days,
            'health_days',
                request.health_days,
            'maintenance_days',
                request.maintenance_days
        ),
        cleanup_result.result,
        NOW(),
        NOW()
    FROM request_data request
    CROSS JOIN cleanup_result
    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN request.dry_run = TRUE
            THEN 'cleanup_dry_run_completed'
        ELSE 'cleanup_completed'
    END AS result,

    request.dry_run,

    (
        SELECT result
        FROM cleanup_result
    ) AS cleanup_result,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM inserted_run
    ) AS maintenance_run_id

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## Cleanup کنترل‌شده

پیش‌فرض dry_run=true است.

فقط Log و Eventهای قدیمی حذف می‌شوند؛ داده‌های اصلی بیمار، نوبت، Consent، پیام و Dead Letter خودکار حذف نمی‌شوند.

ابتدا Dry Run را بررسی کن و سپس dry_run=false اجرا کن.
